entries.title: Amos 5:1
segments:
CHAP. V. 
 
  The deplorable condition of Israel, ver. 1-3.   An exhortation to seek God, ver. 4-15.   Judgments denounced, ver. 16-20.   Notwithstanding their outward services, ver. 21-27.

entries.title: Amos 5:2
segments: V. 2. The virgin-So she was, when first espoused to God. Upon her land-Broken to pieces upon her own land, and so left as a broken vessel.

entries.title: Amos 5:3
segments: V. 3. By a thousand-That sent out one thousand soldiers. An hundred-Shall lose nine parts of them.

entries.title: Amos 5:4
segments: V. 4. Ye shall live-It shall be well with you.

entries.title: Amos 5:5
segments: V. 5. Seek not-Consult not, worship not the idol at Bethel, Gilgal, or Beersheba.

entries.title: Amos 5:6
segments: V. 6. The house of Joseph-The kingdom of the ten tribes, the chief whereof was Ephraim, the son of Joseph.  In Beth-el-If once this fire breaks out, all your idols in Beth-el shall not be able to quench it.

entries.title: Amos 5:7
segments: V. 7. Ye-Rulers and judges.  Judgment-The righteous sentence of the law.  To wormwood-Proverbially understood; bitterness, injustice and oppression.  Leave off-Make to cease in your courts of judicature.

entries.title: Amos 5:8
segments: V. 8. The seven stars-A constellation, whose rising about September was usually accompanied with sweet showers.  Orion-Which arising about November brings usually cold, rains and frosts intermixt very seasonable for the earth.  The shadow of the earth-The greatest adversity into as great prosperity.  Dark with might-Changes prosperity into adversity. That calleth-Commands the vapour to ascend, which he turns into rain; and then pours from the clouds to make the earth fruitful.

entries.title: Amos 5:9
segments: V. 9. The strong-The mighty, victorious and insolent. Shall come-Shall rally and form a siege against their besiegers.

entries.title: Amos 5:10
segments: V. 10. They-The judges and people.  In the gate-Where judges sat, and where the prophets many times delivered their message.

entries.title: Amos 5:11
segments: V. 11. Your treading-You utterly oppress the helpless. Ye take-Ye extort from the poor great quantities of wheat, on which he should live.

entries.title: Amos 5:12
segments: V. 12. In the gate-In their courts of justice.

entries.title: Amos 5:13
segments: V. 13. Shall keep silence-Be forced to it.  Evil-Both for the sinfulness of it, and for the troubles, wars, and captivity now at hand.

entries.title: Amos 5:14
segments: V. 14. With you-To bless and save you yet.

entries.title: Amos 5:15
segments: V. 15. The evil-All evil among the people, and yourselves. Love-Commend, encourage, defend: let your heart be toward good things, and good men.  Remnant-What the invasions of enemies, or the civil wars have spared, and left in Samaria and Israel.

entries.title: Amos 5:16
segments: V. 16. Therefore-The prophet foreseeing their obstinacy, proceeds to denounce judgment against them.  The husbandman-This sort of men are little used to such ceremonies of mourning, but now such also shall be called upon; leave your toil, betake yourselves to publick mourning.

entries.title: Amos 5:17
segments: V. 17. Vineyards-In these places were usually the greatest joy. Pass through-To punish all every where.

entries.title: Amos 5:18
segments: V. 18. That desire-Scoffingly, not believing any such day would come. To what end-What do you think to get by it?  Is darkness-All adversity, black and doleful.  Not light-No joy, or comfort an it.

entries.title: Amos 5:19
segments: V. 19. And a bear-You may escape one, but shall fall in another calamity.  Into the house-At home you may hope for safety, but there other kind of mischief shall meet you.

entries.title: Amos 5:21
segments: V. 21. I hate-Impure and unholy as they are.  Will not smell-A savour, of rest or delight, I will not accept and be pleased with.

entries.title: Amos 5:23
segments: V. 23. Thy songs-Used in their sacrifices, and solemn feasts; herein they imitated the temple-worship, but all was unpleasing to the Lord. Will not hear-Not with delight and acceptance.  Thy viols-This one kind of musical instrument is put for all the rest.

entries.title: Amos 5:24
segments: V. 24. Let judgment-Let justice be administered constantly. Righteousness-Equity.  Stream-Bearing down all that opposes it.

entries.title: Amos 5:25
segments: V. 25. Have ye-Their fathers and they, tho' at so great a distance of time, are one people, and so the prophet considers them. Unto me-Was it to me, or to your idols, that you offered, even in the wilderness?

entries.title: Amos 5:26
segments: V. 26. Ye have borne-Ye carried along with you in the wilderness; the shrine, or canopy in which the image was placed. Moloch-The great idol of the Ammonites.  Chiun-Another idol.

entries.title: Amos 5:27
segments: V. 27. Therefore-For all your idolatry and other sins, in which you have obstinately continued.
